calc_items.title: EEG discharge frequency
calc_items.question: A generalized spike-wave pattern shows 18 cycles in 6 seconds. What is its frequency?
calc_items.trap: Do not confuse number of cycles with duration.

calc_items.title: EEG period per cycle
calc_items.question: A discharge runs at 2.5 Hz. What is the approximate period of one cycle, in milliseconds?

calc_items.title: Seizure burden
calc_items.question: Over 60 minutes of EEG, six electrographic seizures last 40, 55, 35, 60, 50 and 60 seconds. What is the percent seizure burden?
calc_items.trap: Convert monitoring duration to seconds first.

calc_items.title: Dextrose % from GIR (repair)
calc_items.question: At 120 mL/kg/day, what dextrose concentration (%) supplies a GIR of 7 mg/kg/min?
calc_items.trap: Do not omit the 144 conversion factor.

calc_items.title: F-75 daily volume (repair)
calc_items.question: A 7.5-kg child is ordered F-75 at 130 mL/kg/day. What is the total volume per day?
calc_items.trap: Do not treat the rate as the daily total.

calc_items.title: F-100 kcal conversion (repair)
calc_items.question: At a 1 kcal/mL F-100 equivalent, what theoretical volume supplies 1,350 kcal?
calc_items.trap: Theoretical equivalence is not a clinical fluid prescription.

calc_items.title: D10 glucose mass (repair)
calc_items.question: A child receives 27.5 mL of D10. How much glucose is delivered?
calc_items.trap: D10 is 10 g/100 mL, not 10 g/mL.

calc_items.title: Corrected age
calc_items.question: An infant born at 29 weeks GA is now 15 weeks old. What is the corrected age?
calc_items.trap: PMA = 44 weeks; corrected age is 4 weeks, not 44.
